records.name: Kumartuli Park
records.latest_update: We may have our shortcomings, and our efforts may not always be perfect. 🙏 But isn't keeping our surroundings clean a basic responsibility we all share? We worship Maa Ganga with immense devotion, yet seeing her waters filled with chips packets, plastic bottles, and other waste is truly disheartening. 🌊 Respect for Maa Ganga should not end with our prayers; it should reflect in our actions. Let us not focus only on the mistakes of others. A little awareness, civic sense, and responsibility from each of us can make a big difference. Maa Ganga belongs to us all. Keeping her clean is not just a committee's responsibility—it is everyone's duty. 🙏 #KumartuliPark #MaaGanga #SaveGanga #CleanGanga #CivicSense #kolkata
